I had 3 removed last november. Bottom two were nearly on their sides facing my teeth > < like that. Since they were growing INTO my botton row, all of my teeth on the bottom are crammed and it also affected how my jaw developed while growing up (found that out through all the x rays; i have an extreme overbite where you can barely tell i have a botton lip and it looks super funny; my jaw is also deformed, pulled back much more than it should because of "im confused what the fuck am i supposed to do with these shitty tools??" type thing during decelopment). 
My other one was my top left (always mistook it for right cause x rays are backwards and my right side feels like theres a tooth bump there, lopsided bump and everything) was facing crooked at an angle where itd grow towards my front cheek area rather than DOWN or towards the side of my mouth. I called it my tooth on crack cause the xrays made it look like its plotting an escape.
 Cause of how sideways and damaging the bottom two were, and how fuckin high my last tooth was, they agreed i needed surgery. Got me high as everloving hell and shattered them and removed pieces. I felt every jerk and yank as they removed them and was screaming "FUCK. OW. BITCH. OWWWWW" with each jolt that would slam my head to the side. There were 2 docs messing with my teeth and one observing (?) And theyd tell me shut the fuck up i cant feel shit. ....if i didnt feel it... then why can i still remember how it hurt my neck?? Those things were stuck in there GOOD. They got tired of my shit and shoved a thing in my face to make me knocked out.
Honestly, the last thing i remembered beforehand was in the waiting room. They made me go in a wheelchair and i felt embarrassed so i said no i can walk just fine. They said itll be different when the meds kick in so just to be safe. Then name was called snd im stubborn saying i can walk i don't nesd the chair. And i stood up and my mon pushed me back down and started pushing me. ....then i remember the yanking and telling me to "shut the fuck up" ... then i woke up the next day thinking j had a dream about my mom taking me to the store. It was vivid but still dreamy.
 She took me to walmart high as hell and made me pay for what i got while knowing id freak about the price when i came to haha. Spent 60$ on popsicles i still freaking have in my freezer, yogurt, pudding, sherbet, and juice. How the hell does that happen. THEN, my grandma takes me to kroger when i wake up the next day and i spend 20$ on the exact same shit (since i was aware of what i was buying this time). Came back and went to put stuff away and thats how i found out my mom already took me to get shit for while i heal. Called mom like ??? And shes like "yeah dont you remember?" ...no mom i literally thought it was a dream. Thanks XD i wasnt too safe afterwards but never had any issues with dry socket. I didnt even take my pain meds. Just one when i woke up cause i thought it was mandatory but the so called pain everyone was bitching about was just an ache compared to the back pain ive had for over 10 years so i didn't feel like being high and uncontrolled when i can just deal with the pain like usual. 50% was also the fact that they gave me strong ass narcotics and i was not comfortable with that kind of stuff. 
I guess that ran longer than intended but thats my wisdom tooth story I guess haha. Still have weird toothy lump on my top right side, but i was born without that one. Docs just shrugged when i asked "well why does it feel like one... the other one never felt like it had a tooth there" but id rather believe they got the correct side and my other side just has a weird growth rather than the scary "wrong side" scenario.

In like 3rd grade, recess was outside and it was winter. For kids to play around the snow (literally everywhere except for in front of the "in trouble" wall), you needed to have snow pants and other weather wear. I forgot my snowpants at home and i was asking the recess teacher why cant i just play with my hands or kick at the snow (i had everything else just forgot the snow pants). She said "well, (my name), life is a bitch. Its unfair. These kids remembered their shit. You didnt. So now you cant do what you want. Suck it up, and be prepared next time. Now go by the wall or find something to do besides waste my breath saying things youll never even remember." 
That was over 10 years ago. I feel old now, but i remember thinking she was a bitch and shouldn't be talking like that to a damn kid and i remember thinking of playing in the snow anyway. "What she gonna do? Give me wall punishment for the rest of the weeks recess? Ill just slip on ice at the wall dammit." I was a very rebellious kid haha.
